# CO2 emissions
```{r emission vars}
total <- c(all = "Emi|CO2|Buildings",
           res = "Emi|CO2|Residential",
           com = "Emi|CO2|Commercial")
```

```{r energy loop, results='asis'}
for (eu in enduse) {
  
  heading(eu, 2)

  for (sec in names(total)) {
    tot <- paste(total[[sec]], eu, sep = "|")
    
    if (!tot %in% data$variable) next
    
    heading(sec, 3)
    
    showAreaBarLinePlots(data = data, tot = tot, items = carrierHeating)
    
    showAreaBarLinePlots(data = data, tot = paste(tot, type, sep = "|"), items = carrierHeating,
                         heading = "by Building type", nHeading = 4)
    
    showAreaBarLinePlots(data = data, tot = paste(tot, location, sep = "|"), items = carrierHeating,
                         heading = "by Location", nHeading = 4)
  }
}
```
